brief.title: Lanterns of the Night Market
brief.logline: A cozy deckbuilder about running a food stall in a floating night market, where every recipe is a card and every regular has a story.

anchors.name: Slay the Spire
anchors.creator: Mega Crit Games
anchors.description: We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

anchors.name: Spiritfarer
anchors.creator: Thunder Lotus Games
anchors.description: Spiritfarer is a cozy, hand-drawn management and adventure game about death and saying goodbye. You play as a ferrymaster who builds and upgrades a boat, explores mystical seas, farms, mines, fishes, cooks and crafts, befriends spirit passengers, learns their stories, cares for their needs, and ultimately helps them move on to the afterlife. The game emphasizes relaxation, emotional storytelling, character-driven…

anchors.name: DAVE THE DIVER
anchors.creator: MINT ROCKET
anchors.description: Dave the Diver is an action-adventure with simulation elements where you explore the mysterious Blue Hole diving for fish and treasures by day, then run and grow a sushi restaurant by night, uncovering a deeper narrative about three friends and the sea's secrets.

entity.name: Inscryption
entity.creator: Daniel Mullins Games
entity.description: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey that blends deckbuilding roguelike runs, escape-room-style puzzles, and psychological horror, with hidden meta-narrative secrets encoded in the cards.

entity.name: Cult of the Lamb
entity.creator: Massive Monster
entity.description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets: recruit and manage woodland followers, build and upgrade a cult settlement, perform dark rituals, and raid randomized regions to defeat rival cult leaders and become the one true cult.

entity.name: Death's Door
entity.creator: Acid Nerve
entity.description: You play as a Crow whose job is to reap souls; when an assigned soul is stolen you chase the thief into a realm untouched by death, battling overgrown beasts and tyrants while uncovering a somber, darkly comic mystery about the nature of the Doors and the flow of souls.

entity.name: Risk of Rain 2
entity.creator: Hopoo Games
entity.description: Risk of Rain 2 is a third-person multiplayer roguelike shooter in which players fight escalating hordes of monsters on an alien planet, collect powerful loot, unlock survivors and items across runs, and attempt to escape before difficulty spirals out of control.

entity.name: Genshin Impact
entity.creator: miHoYo
entity.description: Genshin Impact is a free-to-play action RPG set in the open fantasy world of Teyvat. Players control a party of up to four characters, explore a large seamless world, solve environmental puzzles, master elemental combinations in combat, and follow an episodic story about a traveller searching for a lost sibling while uncovering deeper mysteries.

entity.name: Omori
entity.creator: OMOCAT
entity.description: A surreal, story-driven RPG that alternates between a colorful dream world and a quiet real world as a withdrawn protagonist confronts trauma and repressed memories; player choices shape multiple possible endings.

entity.name: DREDGE
entity.creator: Black Salt Games
entity.description: Dredge is a fishing-focused action-adventure where you captain a small dredging vessel, catch fish, sell your haul, upgrade your boat and recover long-buried relics while uncovering disturbing secrets in a chain of islands; exploration and trade mix with slow-burn, Lovecraftian-tinged horror as locals reveal strange stories and the deeper threat grows.

entity.name: Eastward
entity.creator: Pixpil
entity.description: Eastward is a beautifully crafted adventure game that follows the journey of a duo in a world on the brink of destruction. Set in a post-apocalyptic world, players take on the roles of an unlikely couple, John and Sam, as they embark on a roadtrip through decaying towns and bustling cities, meeting quirky characters and formidable creatures along the way.

entity.name: TOEM
entity.creator: Something We Made
entity.description: Embark on a charming journey to explore a magical world, solving puzzles and capturing moments through photography.

entity.name: CrossCode
entity.creator: Radical Fish Games
entity.description: CrossCode is a retro-inspired 2D action RPG that pairs 16-bit SNES-style pixel graphics with fluid physics, fast-paced melee/shooting combat and Zelda-like dungeon puzzles, all wrapped in a sci-fi mystery narrative set inside a virtual MMO-like world.

entity.name: Loop Hero
entity.creator: Four Quarters
entity.description: Loop Hero is an indie roguelike deck-building RPG in which a cursed world is trapped in a repeating loop; players place cards to create terrain, buildings and enemies along the hero's autonomous path, then watch runs play out and use resources to expand the camp and unlock long-term upgrades.

entity.name: Tunic
entity.creator: ISOMETRICORP Games
entity.description: Tunic is an isometric action-adventure about a tiny fox exploring a large, mysterious world. Players explore ancient ruins, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and uncover cryptic secrets and lore presented through environmental storytelling and an in-game pictographic manual. The game emphasizes discovery, careful observation, and rewarding exploration in a stylized, charming isometric world.

entity.name: Monster Train
entity.creator: Shiny Shoe
entity.description: Monster Train is a tactical roguelike deck-building game set on a runaway train bound for Hell. Players build and evolve decks of monsters and spells, position units across multiple vertical battlefields, and make strategic decisions each run to stop celestial pursuers. The game emphasizes replayability, strategic depth, and layered lane-based combat with rich card interactions.

entity.name: Temtem
entity.creator: Crema Games
entity.description: Every kid dreams about becoming a Temtem tamer; explore the six islands of the Airborne Archipelago, catch and train Temtem, battle other tamers, defeat Clan Belsoto, and become the ultimate Temtem tamer.

entity.name: Raft
entity.description: Raft throws you and your friends into an oceanic survival sandbox: alone or together, players scavenge debris, craft tools, expand a floating base and explore islands while fending off man-eating sharks and managing hunger, thirst and resources.

entity.name: Spelunky 2
entity.creator: Mossmouth
entity.description: Spelunky 2 builds on the original's randomized, high-risk exploration, sending a new generation of explorers to the Moon to hunt treasure and find missing family across deadly, procedurally generated caves in a roguelike platformer.

entity.name: Curse of the Dead Gods
entity.creator: Passtech Games
entity.description: You are a greedy treasure hunter drawn into an accursed temple — a procedurally generated labyrinth of traps, monsters and bottomless pits. Die and rise repeatedly as you gather weapons, mystical relics and powerful curses; balance the benefits of corruption against its destructive effects as you delve deeper to defy the malignant deities that dwell within.

entity.name: Cocoon
entity.creator: Geometric Interactive
entity.description: COCOON is a puzzle-adventure in which each environment exists as a small world contained in an orb you carry on your back; you jump between and rearrange these worlds to solve layered, spatial puzzles while exploring alien biomes and uncovering an ancient cosmic mystery.

entity.name: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling
entity.creator: Moonsprout Games
entity.description: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling is a 2D, party-based role-playing adventure that follows three insect heroes as they explore the Land of Bugaria. Players combine each character's unique abilities to solve environmental puzzles, overcome turn-based battles that use timed-action commands, and uncover ancient treasures and secrets in a colorful, paper-like world that pays homage to classic RPGs.

entity.name: Subnautica: Below Zero
entity.creator: Unknown Worlds Entertainment
entity.description: Subnautica: Below Zero is a first-person open-world survival adventure set one year after the original Subnautica on alien Planet 4546B. Stranded in a frozen polar region, you scavenge wreckage, craft tools and bases, tame or evade fauna, and investigate a catastrophic incident at an underwater research facility while uncovering new story threads and environmental mysteries.

entity.name: Noita
entity.creator: Nolla Games
entity.description: Noita is a physics-driven magical action roguelite where every pixel is simulated; you explore procedurally generated caverns, craft and combine spells, and use emergent interactions (melt, burn, freeze, evaporate) to survive before inevitable death.

entity.name: Hades
entity.creator: Supergiant Games
entity.description: Hades is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where players control Zagreus, the son of Hades, as he attempts to escape from the Underworld. The game is set in a Greek mythology-inspired world and combines fast-paced hack-and-slash combat with a rich narrative and character interactions.

entity.name: Moonlighter
entity.creator: Digital Sun
entity.description: Moonlighter is an action RPG with roguelite elements that follows the dual life of a shopkeeper who by day runs a store and by night explores procedurally generated dungeons to gather loot, upgrade gear, and uncover secrets. The game blends fast-paced pixel-art combat, risk/reward dungeon runs, and shopkeeping/management mechanics in a loop-driven progression.

entity.name: Outer Wilds
entity.creator: Mobius Digital, LLC
entity.description: Outer Wilds is an open-world exploration mystery in which the player explores a small solar system trapped in a repeating time loop, investigating extinct civilizations, planetary hazards, and hidden secrets to uncover why the loop exists.

entity.name: Everything Everywhere All at Once
entity.creator: Daniel Kwan
entity.description: Everything Everywhere All at Once (2022), directed by Daniel Kwan and Daniel Scheinert, stars Michelle Yeoh alongside Stephanie Hsu and Jamie Lee Curtis in a genre-defying mix of action, sci‑fi, comedy and drama. The film follows a middle-aged Chinese immigrant who must access alternate versions of herself across a multiverse to confront a destructive force while navigating fraught family relationships. It interro…

entity.name: Soul
entity.description: Soul (2020) is an American computer-animated film from Pixar directed by Pete Docter and co-directed by Kemp Powers. Starring Jamie Foxx, Tina Fey and Graham Norton, the film mixes comedy and drama with musical and fantastical elements as it follows a middle-school music teacher whose accidental journey into a metaphysical realm forces him to reevaluate his passions and what gives life meaning. Through lush, contr…

entity.name: Encanto
entity.creator: Charise Castro Smith,Jared Bush
entity.description: Encanto (2021) is an animated musical fantasy directed by Jared Bush and Byron Howard and featuring voice performances from Stephanie Beatriz, María Cecilia Botero, and John Leguizamo. The film follows the Madrigal family, who live in a magical house in the Colombian mountains where each child receives a unique gift—except Mirabel, who must confront feelings of exclusion and work to save her family's fading miracl…

entity.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
entity.description: The Mitchells vs. the Machines (2021) is an animated adventure-comedy directed by Mike Rianda and Jeff Rowe and produced in part by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller. Voiced by Abbi Jacobson, Danny McBride and Maya Rudolph, the film follows a quirky family's road trip that becomes the front line in a global robot uprising. Combining energetic action, rapid-fire humor and a sketchy mixed-media animation style, the m…

entity.name: Luca
entity.creator: Enrico Casarosa
entity.description: Luca (2021), directed by Enrico Casarosa and featuring the voices of Jacob Tremblay, Jack Dylan Grazer, and Emma Berman, is a Pixar animated coming-of-age adventure set on the Italian Riviera. The story follows a shy young sea creature who, disguised as a human, forms a deep friendship with an audacious peer and a spirited local girl as they pursue a dream involving a treasured scooter and enter a town race. Blend…

entity.name: Free Guy
entity.creator: Shawn Levy
entity.description: Free Guy (2021), directed by Shawn Levy and starring Ryan Reynolds, Jodie Comer and Taika Waititi, is a high-concept action-comedy with science-fiction and romantic elements. It follows a bank teller who learns he is a non-player character in an open-world video game and becomes a self-aware hero trying to save the virtual world. The film blends blockbuster set-piece action and visual effects with warm humor and e…

entity.name: Dune
entity.creator: Denis Villeneuve
entity.description: Dune: Part One (2021), directed by Denis Villeneuve and starring Timothée Chalamet, Rebecca Ferguson, and Zendaya, is an action-adventure science-fiction drama adapted from Frank Herbert's novel. It follows the heir of House Atreides as his family takes stewardship of a desert planet whose exclusive spice ignites political rivalry, betrayal, and war. The film balances intimate coming-of-age drama with grand worldb…

entity.name: Barbie
entity.creator: Greta Gerwig
entity.description: Barbie (2023), directed by Greta Gerwig and starring Margot Robbie, Ryan Gosling and Issa Rae, is an adventure-comedy-fantasy that follows inhabitants of an idealized toy world who travel to the human world and must reckon with identity, gender expectations, and fame. The film pairs broad, whimsical musical set pieces and vivid production design with pointed satirical commentary about commercialization, patriarchy…

entity.name: Raya and the Last Dragon
entity.creator: Paul Briggs
entity.description: Raya and the Last Dragon (2021), directed by Don Hall and Carlos López Estrada, is an animated action-adventure featuring voices from Kelly Marie Tran, Awkwafina and Gemma Chan and a score noted by reviewers to be by James Newton Howard. Set in the mythic realm of Kumandra, the film follows warrior Raya as she seeks the last dragon to heal a broken land, blending action-packed sequences with humorous and heartfelt…

entity.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
entity.creator: Jon Watts
entity.description: Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021), directed by Jon Watts and starring Tom Holland, Zendaya, and Benedict Cumberbatch, is a blockbuster superhero action-adventure that uses multiversal fantasy and sci‑fi elements to escalate emotional stakes. After the protagonist’s identity is exposed he asks a sorcerer for help, and a botched spell brings dangerous adversaries from other dimensions. The narrative centers on themes o…

entity.name: The World According to Jeff Goldblum
entity.description: The World According to Jeff Goldblum (2019) is a documentary-comedy series fronted by Jeff Goldblum, with Greg Newkirk and Andrew Freeman appearing, that examines everyday objects and activities through curious, personality-led investigations. Each episode pairs on-location visits and interviews with experts and enthusiasts to reveal scientific, cultural, and historical connections in accessible, humorous ways. Th…

entity.name: Watership Down
entity.description: Watership Down (2018) is an animated miniseries adaptation of Richard Adams' novel, released in 2018 and featuring voice performances from James McAvoy, Nicholas Hoult, and John Boyega. Framed as a tense, character-driven fantasy adventure, it follows a group of rabbits fleeing a destroyed warren and seeking a safe new home. The series blends visceral survival sequences and occasional surreal visions with themes o…

entity.name: Cells at Work!
entity.description: Cells at Work! (2018) is a Japanese animated series that anthropomorphizes human blood and immune cells into character-driven figures who defend and maintain the body. Starring Mamiko Noto (Japanese) and English-language performers including Karen Strassman and Dorah Fine, the show mixes comedy, action, and fantasy to dramatize immunology and pathology. Episodes range from light, humorous vignettes to longer arcs…

entity.name: After Hours
entity.description: After Hours (2010) is an American comedy web series featuring Soren Bowie, Michael Swaim, and Anthony Clark that centers on four co-workers who obsessively dissect movies, video games, and pop culture. Episodes unfold as conversational late-night panels punctuated by stylized animated interludes and sketches, turning fannish nitpicking into comedic set pieces. The series blends satire, nostalgia, and media critici…

entity.name: 6 Days to Air: The Making of South Park
entity.description: 6 Days to Air: The Making of South Park is a 2011 short television documentary directed by Arthur Bradford that follows creators and staff including Trey Parker, Matt Stone and Anne Garefino. The film documents the six-day process of developing, writing, and finishing a topical animated episode, interweaving workroom footage with anecdotes about the show's history. It highlights the collaborative decision-making,…

entity.name: Llamas with Hats
entity.description: Llamas with Hats (2009) is a short-form animated web series starring Jason Steele and Chris Alex that blends dark comedy, surreal fantasy, and horror. The episodes follow two anthropomorphic llamas living together as one becomes progressively violent and unhinged, transforming absurd sketches into a continuous, character-driven arc. Over its run the series escalates from wacky, offbeat humor to tense, tragic drama…

entity.name: Redwall
entity.description: Redwall is a 2001 animated family-fantasy television adaptation of Brian Jacques' novels that follows anthropomorphic animals defending an abbey from marauding vermin. The series centers on a humble young mouse who is inspired by visions of a legendary warrior and must grow into a leader, blending action, drama, and coming-of-age elements. Noted for its colorful, storybook visuals, memorable musical themes, and st…

entity.name: Larry Charles' Dangerous World of Comedy
entity.description: Larry Charles' Dangerous World of Comedy (2019) is a documentary-comedy series created and led by Larry Charles that follows him as he travels to volatile and unconventional places to study how people use humor amid danger. Featuring Larry Charles alongside contributors such as Adrianne Chalepah and Thom Tran, the show combines interviews, live performances and embedded reporting to profile comedians and communiti…

entity.name: Mystery Science Theater 3000
entity.description: Mystery Science Theater 3000 (2017) is a revival of the cult series that places a human test subject aboard the Satellite of Love to endure a steady diet of B-movies while an ensemble of hosts, robots and mad scientists provide running commentary. The 2017 return retains the original's core conceit—sketch-based framing sequences plus movie riffing—while modernizing production values and joke pacing. Main collabora…

entity.name: 63 Up
entity.description: 63 Up (2019), directed by Michael Apted, is a biographical documentary installment in the long-running Up series that revisits the same group of participants seven years after the previous film. Featuring contributors such as Tony Walker, John Brisby, and Jacqueline Bassett, it records candid interviews about family, work, health, class, and retirement. The film functions as a sociological longitudinal study, trac…

entity.name: Masayoshi Soken
entity.description: Masayoshi Soken is a Japanese composer, arranger, and sound director primarily recognized for his extensive work on the Final Fantasy video game series, particularly Final Fantasy XIV. His music blends orchestral, jazz fusion, rock, and electronic elements, creating dynamic and memorable soundtracks that enhance the gaming experience. Soken is also known for his live performances and involvement in the production…

entity.name: Rozen
entity.description: Rozen is a music artist primarily known for pop and rock music. Specific details about their biography, vocal range, and other attributes are not widely documented.

entity.name: Bayonetta
entity.description: Bayonetta is a fictional character and the main protagonist of the Bayonetta video game series developed by PlatinumGames. She is a powerful witch with magical abilities, known for her stylish combat and charismatic personality. The series features a blend of action, hack and slash gameplay with a distinctive soundtrack combining orchestral, electronic, and jazz elements.

entity.name: Mili
entity.description: Mili is a Japanese indie music group formed in 2012, known for their unique fusion of electronic music, classical crossover, and indie pop. Their sound often incorporates intricate arrangements, ethereal vocals, and a blend of traditional and modern instrumentation. The group has gained a dedicated following for their innovative approach to music and their contributions to various multimedia projects including vid…

entity.name: Yasunori Nishiki
entity.description: Yasunori Nishiki is a Japanese composer and arranger renowned for his work in video game music, particularly orchestral and classical styles. He has contributed to various game soundtracks and is recognized for blending traditional orchestral elements with modern electronic and jazz influences.

entity.name: DM DOKURO
entity.description: DM Dokuro is an electronic music producer specializing in chiptune and video game music styles, blending nostalgic 8-bit sounds with modern electronic production techniques. His work often features synthwave and ambient influences, creating immersive and nostalgic soundscapes.

entity.name: Manaka Kataoka
entity.description: Manaka Kataoka is a Japanese singer and voice actress recognized for her contributions to anime music and voice roles. She has performed theme songs and character songs, showcasing her vocal talents in the Japanese entertainment industry.

entity.name: Keigo Hoashi
entity.description: Keigo Hoashi is a Japanese jazz pianist and composer recognized for his unique approach to jazz and fusion music. He blends traditional jazz elements with contemporary and experimental sounds, creating a distinctive instrumental style. Hoashi is noted for his expressive piano playing and compositional skills, contributing to the modern jazz scene in Japan and internationally.

entity.name: Laura Shigihara
entity.description: Laura Shigihara is a Japanese-American singer-songwriter, composer, and video game developer best known for composing the soundtrack and performing vocals for the popular indie game 'Plants vs. Zombies.' She blends elements of chiptune, pop, and folk music in her compositions, often creating catchy and emotionally resonant melodies. Besides composing, she is also a game developer and has released her own games and…

entity.name: Pascal Michael Stiefel
entity.description: Pascal Michael Stiefel is a Swiss singer-songwriter and musician recognized for his melodic blend of pop and rock music. He has built a reputation for heartfelt lyrics and engaging melodies, contributing to the contemporary Swiss music scene.

copy.title: Comp line
copy.body: Inscryption meets Cult of the Lamb: a card-driven game with replayable structure and charming art, here set at a food stall in a floating night market. Both comps score high for fit with the touchstone audience (0.94 and 0.89), and both sit in the Mid-list, Top 3-4%.

copy.author: llm

copy.title: Store page & publisher pitch
copy.body: If you like the replayable, mechanics-first design of Inscryption and the addictive progression and charming art of Cult of the Lamb, Lanterns of the Night Market gives you a calmer take on the same loop. You run a food stall in a floating night market. Every recipe is a card, and every regular has a story. It draws on the deckbuilding of Slay the Spire, the warmth of Spiritfarer and the run-to-run cooking and service rhythm of DAVE THE DIVER and Cook, Serve, Delicious!. For players who also enjoyed the atmosphere of DREDGE or the whimsy of Eastward, it offers a similar sense of place with lower stakes.

copy.title: Who it's for
copy.body: The touchstone audience over-indexes on puzzle, roguelike, strategy, simulation, adventure and turn-based play, with psychological horror and science fiction also in the mix. Skew by gender is slight (male +0.08, female -0.08). Age skew is negative across most bands, with 45-54 the lowest at -0.23, so this is not a narrow youth audience. The same people also like Everything Everywhere All at Once, Encanto and Luca on film, and The Adventure Zone and The Polygon Show among podcasts. They are reachable through Twitch. Markets with the strongest signal: Las Vegas and Portland (strongholds), Madison (hidden gem), and emerging interest in Raleigh, Oklahoma City and Boston. This is aggregate taste, not a forecast.

kit.headline: Slay the Spire-style deckbuilding meets the Spiritfarer and DAVE THE DIVER comfort loop, aimed at the audience already playing Inscryption and Cult of the Lamb.
kit.summary: Lanterns of the Night Market sits where roguelike deckbuilding meets cozy management, close to Inscryption and Cult of the Lamb in fit and in audience. It is for players who like strategy, simulation and roguelike structure with warm, character-led worlds. Lead with the recipe-as-card hook and the regulars' stories, and use DREDGE and Eastward as niche signals of appetite for quirky, atmospheric indie worlds.
